operations.summary: Fit (sigma_E/E)^2 = a^2/E + b^2/E^2 + c^2 to (E, sigma_E/E[, uncertainty]) points by exact linear least squares (weighted by the input uncertainties, else by a constant relative uncertainty), or evaluate given a, b, c; reports the per-term breakdown, the dominant term and the crossover energies

inputs.name: fit
inputs.constraint: JSON object with a points list [[E, sigma_E/E(, uncertainty)], ...]; sigma_E/E a fraction (<= 1); at least three distinct energies; excludes --evaluate

inputs.name: evaluate
inputs.constraint: evaluate the given coefficients instead of fitting; excludes --fit

inputs.name: valid_range
inputs.constraint: evaluate: LOW HIGH of the fitted range, LOW <= HIGH

inputs.name: status
inputs.constraint: one of the core artifact_statuses; echoed as status (default: the --fit file's status, else unvalidated)

failure_states.meaning: the fit input's content is invalid, or a squared coefficient fitted negative (all roots null, ok false, the reason in warnings), or the result is not representable

an argument is missing, malformed or out of range, or the fit input file is missing or unreadable; stdout carries {"status": "failed", "ok": false, "error_kind": "invalid-input", "error": ...} and stderr the usage and one error line

assumptions: three-term core a/sqrt(E) (+) b/E (+) c with design coefficients
no leakage, intercalibration or non-uniformity in c
figures_of_merit.note: ADQ-05: --evaluate with design coefficients is optimistic (the constant term excludes leakage, intercalibration and non-uniformity; the low-side leakage tail is not in the formula); --fit on measured points is not mapped for design evaluations
